reason: Cursor's workspace-slug transcript layout is not a portable history source; use the destination harness's scoped history.

edits.before: Transcripts live at `~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl`, where `<slug>` is the workspace path with the leading slash dropped and each "/" turned into "-" (so `/Users/you/proj` becomes `Users-you-proj`). Every line is one chat message.
edits.after: Locate the active workspace's native session history through the pstack names adapter. Use its session IDs and recorded timestamps, or an explicitly supplied transcript export; do not derive a Cursor directory or assume a message schema. Read no other workspace without authorization. Daybook remains the shared record.
